issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

maxActiveStmts.description: target for maximum concurrent active sql sessions; -1 disables throttling

throttleStmtMinLatency.description: minimum expected latency to start statement throttling

sampleStmtMinLatency.description: minimum sql statement latency in ms that is considered an active session

samplingPeriod.description: period to check my sql active sessions in ms

broadcastPeriod.description: period to notify others about cluster sql active sessions in ms

busySleep.description: if db active sessions is high then sleep for this interval in ms

maxBusyWaitMinute.description:
even if db active sessions is high do not sleep more then this many
minutes
